channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Scissors found in woman’s abdomen 5 years after surgery; Kerala Minister orders probe
item.description: Reacting to the shocking discovery of a surgical instrument inside a patient’s abdomen five years after a procedure, Kerala Health Minister Veena George on Friday said a preliminary report has been received, and an expert panel will examine the entire incident in detail.

item.title: Kejriwal, Bhagwant Mann to visit Gujarat on Feb 21-22 to review local poll preparations
item.description: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) national convenor Arvind Kejriwal and Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann are scheduled to undertake a two‑day visit to Gujarat from February 21, party leaders said on Friday.

item.title: Delhi Police bust robbery syndicate, arrest four
item.description: The police, in a statement, said that on February 16, the information was received at Karol Bagh police station regarding a snatching incident near Ganga Ram Hospital Crossing, wherein the victim had sustained a head injury.

item.title: Bomb threat to Rajasthan High Court’s Jaipur Bench; email mentions RDX, CJI visit
item.description: The Rajasthan High Court's Jaipur Bench received another bomb threat on Friday, triggering a security alert and temporary disruption of court proceedings.

item.title: ECI shares SIR snapshot of net change in electors in Gujarat, Lakshadweep and Puducherry
item.description: The Election Commission of India (ECI) on Friday shared a snapshot of the net changes in the number of electors following the completion of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Gujarat, Lakshadweep and Puducherry.

item.title: Trisha Krishnan seeks blessings at Sri Venkateswara Temple in Tirupati
item.description: Actress Trisha Krishnan visited the sacred Sri Venkateswara Temple in Tirumala and sought divine blessings.

item.title: Telangana High Court Expresses Concern Over GHMC Bifurcation; Notices Issued to Centre and State
item.description: The Telangana High Court on Friday expressed serious concern over the reported bifurcation of the Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation (GHMC), allegedly undertaken despite a freeze imposed by the Central government on boundary alterations in view of the upcoming 2027 Census.

item.title: ‘Truth being portrayed’: BJP leader on Tharoor’s criticism of ‘The Kerala Story 2’
item.description: I haven’t personally seen Kerala 1 or 2… If someone is wrong somewhere, they can be challenged accordingly.

item.title: Massive Fire Breaks Out at Nilgiri Block Near Maitrivanam in Hyderabad; Students Rescued
item.description: In a desperate attempt to save themselves, some students climbed down from the balcony to the lower floors of the building. Dramatic visuals from the scene showed students trying to escape as dense smoke filled the structure.

item.title: Shameful experience, says BJP MP after luggage lost on IndiGo Delhi-Belagavi flight
item.description: BJP's Lok Sabha member Praveen Khandelwal criticised IndiGo on Friday, referring to the airline's baggage mishandling as "shameful" during his recent flight, and highlighted the increasing concerns about passenger experience at the nation's busiest airlines.
